Hymn 239: Choose the Right
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: D Major
Composer: Henry A. Tuckett
Lyricist/Text Author: Joseph L. Townsend
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 239 titled "Choose the Right" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in D Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Henry A. Tuckett and the lyrics were written by Joseph L. Townsend.
This hymn is categorized under: Special Topics.
